brand.title: Our story
brand.metaDescription: GBRAND is a Kenyan apparel brand for people who carry their teams, their towns and their families with them.
brand.intro: GBRAND is a Kenyan apparel brand for people who carry their teams, their towns and their families with them. That's why the map of Kenya sits at the heart of our logo.

promises.title: Shot in hand
promises.body: Every kit on this site is photographed from our own stock. What you see is what arrives.

promises.title: Sizes that fit
promises.body: Size guide on every product, and real advice on WhatsApp if you're between two sizes.

promises.title: All of Kenya
promises.body: Delivery in Nairobi and to all 47 counties through Pickup and trusted couriers.

steps.title: Pick your kit
steps.body: Browse by club, choose your size and add a name and number if you want one.

steps.title: Send your bag
steps.body: Your order goes to us on WhatsApp as one clear message. No forms to repeat.

steps.title: Pay with M-Pesa
steps.body: We confirm stock and delivery fee, then you pay. Simple and on record.

steps.title: Receive it
steps.body: Delivered to your door in Nairobi or to your nearest pickup point upcountry.

footer.blurb: Club jerseys, apparel and accessories. Delivered across Kenya.
footer.previewNote: Preview build. Print fee and policies shown are placeholders until confirmed by GBRAND.

accessoriesSoon.title: Accessories landing soon
accessoriesSoon.body: Caps, scarves and bags. Ask us on WhatsApp what's in stock today.
accessoriesSoon.message: Hi GBRAND, which accessories do you have in stock?

whatsappGeneral: Hi GBRAND, I'd like to ask about your kits.
